incidents.summary: Shawbrook lost its judicial review of Financial Ombudsman decisions concerning mis-sold timeshares, while the National Timeshare Helpline subsequently alleged that compensation remained unpaid.

sources.title: Huge Losses For Shawbrook For Years To Come?
sources.quote: Final decisions by the Financial Ombudsman Service and a failed judicial review by Shawbrook Bank in 2023 led to ratification in the High Court that CLC World and Diamond Fractional members were illegally mis-sold their timeshares as investments.

sources.title: The Shawbrook Bank and Financial Ombudsman (FOS)Timeshare Scandal
sources.quote: Despite a Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) final decision in 2021 and a High Court ruling by Mrs Justice Collins Rice on the 5th of May 2023 in favour of the victims, Shawbrook Bank has yet to pay a penny to those affected by the mis-sold timeshare scandal.

incidents.summary: Shawbrook disclosed that one unit had issued low-quality loans in breach of internal risk rules and set aside £9 million against potential defaults and losses.

sources.title: Huge Losses For Shawbrook For Years To Come?
sources.quote: In 2016, Shawbrook Bank shocked investors by revealing that one of its units accidentally gave out low-quality loans that broke internal risk rules.

sources.title: Huge Losses For Shawbrook For Years To Come?
sources.quote: As a result, it has had to set aside £9m to secure against the likelihood of future defaults and losses on those loans.

positives: Shawbrook used external climate data to complete a quantitative climate-scenario assessment for its TCFD report.
